Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) shows the classic "scimitar sign" on the right side, where an anomalous vein runs parallel to the right heart border. This finding is characteristic of Scimitar syndrome (hypogenetic lung syndrome), which is typically associated with ipsilateral mediastinal deviation to the right due to right lung hypoplasia and often involves an abnormal systemic arterial supply from the inferior aorta.
